worldFact.fact: For over two millennia, the indigenous Igorot elders of Mountain Province have carved their own coffins from hollowed pine trunks to be suspended dozens of metres high on sheer limestone cliffs, believing that positioning ancestors closer to the sky protects them from floods and brings them closer to the spirits.
